name: Rukavychka
author: Holy Pangolin & dos
description: The game was inspired by Ukrainian legend of Rukavychka (glove) - in which an old man lost a glove, which came to be a home for many forest animals big and small: from a little mouse to a huge bear. In the story, the old man takes the glove back, but we imagine a story where the animals can live safely in the magical home. They are lost and we have to lead them to it by a fox from the Ukrainian story, and Wawel Dragon from Polish legends, to unify our nations by social cooperation, and unfold/bring safe future for everyone (including forest beings that also need peace to exist).
